pattern_explanation: Each of these four Ukrainian words looks close to an English word with a different meaning. 'Fabula' (plot) resembles 'fable', 'mahazyn' (shop) resembles 'magazine', 'aktualnyi' (relevant) resembles 'actual', and 'fabryka' (factory) resembles 'fabric'. The similar forms can mislead learners who read a short story.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Ukrainian word 'mahazyn' means a shop, but the English word 'magazine' means a periodical, so never translate 'mahazyn' as 'magazine'.
